title: Conversation Intelligence Record
description: Locked schema for AI Customer Support Intelligence & Phishing Threat Detection System. All 4 team members code against this from hour 0.5 onward.

conversation_id.description: Unique ID for the conversation, e.g. CS-10245

priority.description: Urgency/priority of the conversation — Person 2 (Gemini) output

summary.description: Structured short summary of the thread — Person 2 (Gemini) output
summary.example: Customer reports ₹2,500 deducted but order not confirmed.

customer_request.description: What the customer is explicitly asking for — Person 2 (Gemini) output

resolution_status.description: Whether the issue has been resolved — Person 3 (backend aggregation) output

security_analysis.description: Combined security findings — Person 1 (rules) feeds into Person 2 (Gemini combined-intelligence prompt)

threat_type.description: Type of threat detected, if any

social_engineering.description: Whether a social-engineering technique was detected

technique.description: Specific technique, if social_engineering is Yes/Possible

suspicious_url.description: Whether a suspicious URL was detected — Person 1 (url_check.py) output

url_risk.description: Risk level of any detected URL — Person 1 (url_check.py) output

url_reason.description: Short explanation for the URL risk rating — Person 1 (url_check.py) output

suspicious_email.description: Whether a suspicious email address was detected — Person 1 (email_check.py) output

email_risk.description: Risk level of any detected email address — Person 1 (email_check.py) output

email_reason.description: Short explanation for the email risk rating — Person 1 (email_check.py) output

credential_otp_request.description: Whether the message requests credentials or an OTP

risk_level.description: Overall combined risk level — Person 2 (Gemini combined-intelligence prompt) output

recommended_action.description: Human-readable recommended next step — Person 2 (Gemini) output
recommended_action.example: Escalate for security and payment investigation.

raw_text.description: Original raw conversation/message text, kept for reference/debugging

example_record.summary: Customer reports ₹2,500 deducted but order not confirmed.
example_record.recommended_action: Escalate for security and payment investigation.
example_record.raw_text: Hi, I was charged twice and got a link to 'verify my account'...
